profile_and_lifecycle.fixed_roles: sources exactly reference,observed,glyphmap; reuse existing RegistryInput Path/Size/SHA because pinned artifact identity semantics match. Paths resolve relative to profile. Same actual file may be reference and observed explicitly.
profile_and_lifecycle.entries: Map keyed normalized32bit hexadecimal registry IDs/labels. Each contains reference and observed half-open FILE spans plus explicit decoder narrative|positional. Keys associate evidence only; no implicit registry lookup, liveness/site resolution or status update. Common evidence/provenance at top is sufficient.
profile_and_lifecycle.range_reuse: AddressRange Start/End can represent half-open declared file positions when explicitly documented as FILE offsets. Parse/range arithmetic must support source-file offsets rather than accidentally applying a32bit VMA delta helper. Keep file offsets distinct from VMA mapping; no automatic ISO/ELF/sentinel translation.
profile_and_lifecycle.bounds: Profile/glyphmap readInput-bounded; both regular positive source files may exceed64MiB and be4.24GB. Bounded ReaderAt windows<=64KiB each; endpoint within declared source size, no negative/overflow. Bound entries/total report work. Source streaming SHA and before/after size/mtime/identity recheck complete before any JSON stdout.
profile_and_lifecycle.expanded_text_bound: glyphMaps(decode=true) allows multi-rune alias strings: a small glyphmap plus many tokens can expand very large display text. Set a declared expanded-text/report bound (e.g64KiB per decoded side, unsupported beyond) or compare/hash bounded chunks. Do not infer display-memory bound from native span bytes. No new helper required.
profile_and_lifecycle.isolation: One stream-audit-profile route rejects all other workflow flags/positional args, including apply/output/recipes/registry/fit/texture/snapshot. No input mutation/publication/default canonical paths. Shared profile/glyph JSON scanner rejects duplicates, invalid Unicode, malformed domain before source processing.

decoder_contract.reuse: controls(span, TextScanOptions{Decode:true,Glyphs:forward,PositionalLabels:decoder==positional}), with one explicit style and no retry. glyphMaps(...,true) supplies forward aliases. Decode does not require a header by default; optional headerless narrative is deliberate selected grammar, not fallback success.
decoder_contract.narrative: Source grammar preserves HDR/speaker/setup/HL/icon/pen0/param8 plus glyph/space/line/page/END. Inline4800/B000/D800 consumes exactly8 following payload bytes, even when they contain F800/A000/7000. Unknown words/glyphs/truncated payload/missing END remain unsupported.
decoder_contract.positional: Distinct finite UI grammar: B000 is HL; D800/E000 are pen words; A000 is argument-like icon. Do not run narrative first then retry; no inferred style by success.
decoder_contract.termination: Decoder stops at first grammar-level END (not payload lookalike); consumed bytes=finalEND.Offset+2. Compare consumed bytes separately from selected-span bytes and unconsumed tail lengths/hashes. A consumed match with differing tail is not unqualified exact span/padding/capacity equality.
decoder_contract.no_authoring_readiness: Decoding a setup/opaque/nested token proves syntax and bytes only. No substitution expansion, argument producer/type safety, geometry, visual fit, caller liveness or source-context authoring readiness follows.
decoder_contract.overlapping_grammars: Literal same14B label data is valid in both styles: positional rendersABC with B000HL/D800pen/A000icon; narrative rendersA with B000+8B opaque payload followed END. Explicit source-proven decoder style is required; decode success cannot choose style.

comparison_factors.consumed_bytes: Exact byte identity through END; full-span identity separate. SHA/length and first different byte useful, no giant byte/token dumps needed.
comparison_factors.glyphs: Exact ordered glyph/space words plus separately mapped sameGlyphText with NO whitespace/markup/case normalization. Different glyph aliases may display same text while byte/word equality is false. LINE/PAGE are control facts, not flattened into text-match success.
comparison_factors.controls: Exact non-glyph/non-space token Kind/Word/relativeOffset/Payload sequence, including HDR/speaker/line/page/END. Changed placement after inserted glyph is a control-position mismatch even if ordered control words remain same. If additionally exposing ordered-word-only equality, label it distinctly.
comparison_factors.arguments: Ordered decoded icon/param8 token Kind+Word, without payload-lookalike words or arbitrary raw ranges. Opaque payload equality separately binds each param8 word to its8B payload in ordinal order. Positional B000/D800 tokens are not narrative argument records. No legacy FAULT/SHIFT/GARBLE/SWAP runtime-severity promise.
comparison_factors.unsupported: Profile/identity errors fatal with empty stdout; per-side stream decode/expanded-text failure gives unsupported with diagnostics and unavailable comparison fields (null/omitted, never false/true as completed comparison). Other valid rows continue. Raw span bytes/hashes may remain factual.
comparison_factors.sorting: Deterministic numeric normalized-ID order, preserve explicit ID spelling or emit canonical ID consistently; duplicate normalized keys refuse. Same source path allowed; profile rows do not certify registry entry existence.

historical_source_qualification.actual_consumers: audit_argtok_order_2026_10_01.py delegates reports/text; drafted/multi/sentinel-ground-truth launchers delegate reports/writeback. None of those heuristics may turn differing bytes/tokens into exact audit success.
historical_source_qualification.canonical_EN_boundary: Current encode and plan append DONE already own reviewed canonical source-context EN byte construction and exact installed-content check. This increment takes two explicit baseline sources and does not duplicate automatic prefix/source-context/wrap/encoding policy. Future canonical-EN comparison must bind one explicit encoding policy, not try variants until something matches.
historical_source_qualification.remaining_gap: Observed reference resolution/site completeness, source-to-disc mapping, registry/ledger/status reconciliation and native argument producer closure remain separate. The accepted pointer_check only proves declared physical expected words. Do not infer them from a two-span comparison.
